title: Danish Arabia expedition
text: The Danish Arabia expedition was a Danish scientific expedition to Egypt, Arabia, and Syria. Its principal goal was to elucidate the Old Testament with additional research goals concerned with natural history, geography, and cartography. The expedition began in 1761. It had six members, of whom only Carsten Niebuhr survived, returning to Denmark in 1767. The journey was chronicled by Thorkild Hansen in his 1962 documentary novel Arabia Felix.
